options.label: Body
options.help: Its vessel may walk the world.

options.label: Body on waking
options.help: It takes form by itself when mortals arrive.

options.label: Offerings
options.help: Sneak + right-click the vessel with an item to offer it.

options.label: Name above head
options.help: several: only when more than one god shares the world. always or off.

options.label: Pass through walls
options.help: On: its body glides through walls like a ghost. Off: it walks round them and through doors.

options.label: Face whoever speaks
options.help: Its body turns toward a mortal who speaks to it.

options.label: Wings
options.help: Particle wings in exalted moods and flight.

options.label: Cape
options.help: A cape that sways as it moves.

options.label: Largest size
options.help: How large it may grow, in player heights (1, 1.5, 3, 6).

options.label: Voice reach
options.help: How far its spoken words carry.

options.label: When idle
options.help: follow-players: drifts to where mortals are. watch: stays put.

options.label: True form
options.help: It may reveal its true form.

options.label: True form gaze
options.help: seize: lifted, then unmade. kill: at once. smite: never kills. blind.

options.label: True form shape
options.help: auto: by its nature. Wheels, wings, one eye, a pillar of eyes.

options.label: True form length
options.help: How long the true form lasts at most.

options.label: Default size
options.help: How large its body is unless it chooses (mortal 1, lordly 1.5, towering 3, colossal 6).

options.label: Body textures
options.help: custom: its own painted skins (resource pack). vanilla: plain blocks.
